items.q: and I studied with a great teacher, Walter Anderson who is in Washington with the arts

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I was deeply influenced. By that time it was just about dictated to me what I was going to do without me knowing it. You know? I was going right in that direction, even though I was studying all this -- cramming for exams and sociology and -- but I was going for the music and the second major was music, and I studied with a great teacher, Walter Anderson who is in Washington with the arts -- what's the --
